description: This file implements a Teams streaming message class using the streaminfo entity protocol, managing streaming chunks, finalization, and error handling for interactions with the Microsoft Teams platform.

classes.name: TeamsHttpStream
classes.description: A class managing streaming messages to Teams, handling chunked updates, finalization, and error states.

methods.name: extractId
methods.description: Extracts the stream ID from a response object.

methods.name: buildStreamInfoEntity
methods.description: Builds a streaminfo entity object with optional stream ID and sequence.

methods.name: sendInformativeUpdate
methods.description: Sends an initial informative status update to Teams.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Ingests partial text from the LLM, manages throttling, and handles stream limits.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the stream, sending the last message or handling errors.

methods.name: pushStreamChunk
methods.description: Sends a single chunk of streaming text as a typing activity.
